cases.name: UI scene loads eight native physics objects
name-only edit preserves unrounded transform values
create button adds and selects a new world object
inspector applies name, position and size via command gateway
command result updates real scene transform
reload asks before discarding unsaved edits
delete button removes data and collider
undo restores object ID and collider
walk button switches to live avatar camera
Escape returns to edit mode and releases mouse
